en.title: B.D.S
en.decryption: B (Buddha/The Teacher), D (Dhamma/The Teaching), S (Sangha/The Community). Think of it as: Source -> Content -> Vehicle.

fact.en: Jainism also has a 'Triratna' (Right Faith, Right Knowledge, Right Conduct). Do not confuse these with the Buddhist Triratna.

fact.en: The Sangha in early Buddhism refers specifically to the monastic community, not all lay followers.
